methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.

original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

actual_scope: Independently reconstruct the V45 rank-7 group and losing single-helper control from both pinned PR2942 parent providers, reproduce the five-group stage-1 profile, then trace the published final local profiles into the pinned T74 aggregate arithmetic.

stop_rule: Stop after the V45 local positive/single-negative controls, five-group profile control and pinned T74 aggregate arithmetic. Do not run another lowering census or claim a new selected kappa until stages 2/3, owner chronology and physical/native admission receive source-bound review.
evidence: verify.py independently derives F2 spans by XOR closure, reconstructs the V45 and five-group profiles for both providers, reproduces the final local profiles and exact staged local-price sum, and checks the T74 rank-mass decomposition. A 90-digit Decimal root is only a numerical cross-check. It does not rebuild the stage-2/3 transformations, ownership chronology, native admission, or outer release.
